oichi-1.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a crisp, genuinely transparent RGBA 2D game sprite sheet of EXACTLY SIX successive WALK animation drawings, 3 columns by 2 rows, row-major order. 1536x1024 landscape atlas. No text, grid, ground, shadows, effects or background.
Image 1 is identity/costume reference only. Image 2 is the HIGH PRIORITY skeletal animation reference. Draw the character over EACH of those SIX stick-figure leg poses, precisely matching its knee angles, ankle position, leg overlap and frame order, scaled to the same anatomy; keep original costume and skin colors, do not copy the blue/orange guide colors. BLUE guide = leg nearest camera (in front at overlaps); ORANGE guide = leg away from camera (behind at overlaps). This explicit distinction must persist across all six drawings. Do NOT substitute six versions of a similar stride. Do NOT copy the reference sheet's old incorrect lower-body poses. Do NOT put both feet on the ground where the pose guide shows a lifted swinging foot. Use the guide to redraw, not warp old pictures.
This is PART 1 of one 12-frame loop: frames0..5, NEAR leg is planted and travels from forward contact to back while FAR leg bends, passes it and swings forward. In the final three drawings the NEAR leg is BEHIND and FAR knee is IN FRONT.
All six have same head size, same body scale, pelvis center at each cell center, stable ground baseline and right-facing torso. Natural ordinary walking (not sprinting). Progress gradually through six equally spaced phases; small arm/cloth/hair follow-through. Leave 25px clear margins around entire figure, bow/sword and ponytail. Every limb fully visible without touching another cell. Crisp thick ink outlines and clean cel shading.
Oichi is an ADULT Japanese woman, same slender athletic proportions and slim legs as image1, long high black ponytail with tiny red/gold clasp, white red-trim sleeveless wrap top, red sash and opaque red pleated skirt, black/red bracers, white tabi with red wooden sandals. Bow remains strapped to her back in all frames. Keep costume opaque and covered. Upright head-to-sole height about350px.

rejected_passes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production videogame sprite atlas. Draw exactly 12 independently drawn sequential frames of one complete NORMAL WALK cycle, not a run, facing screen right, same stationary pelvis center and stable scale in every cell. Layout exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, row-major left to right, no text/grid/labels, crisp high resolution 2D ink-and-cel painting, actual transparent alpha background with no cast shadows, no ground. Aim 2048x1536 canvas, each fully visible body about 400px tall and each full weapon/ponytail inside its own cell. Fixed camera, true side/three-quarter right-facing view with same torso orientation throughout. Every frame differs by an equal 1/12 phase of the gait, not duplicated poses or whole-body shifting. Near leg and far leg must visibly alternate forward and backward.
Precise phase plan, frames 0..11:
0 contact: NEAR leg extended forward heel on ground; FAR leg extended back toe on ground.
1 down: near foot moves rearward a little under weight, far heel lifts and far knee bends.
2: near planted foot approaching pelvis, far knee swings forward with lifted toes.
3 passing: NEAR supporting leg nearly vertical; FAR bent knee clearly passes forward beside it, ankles close in x.
4: near supporting foot continues behind pelvis, far shin unfolds forward.
5: near heel lifts at rear, far heel approaches ground well ahead.
6 opposite contact: FAR leg extended forward heel on ground; NEAR leg extended back toe on ground. This must visibly switch which leg is in front.
7 down: far supporting foot moves back, near heel lifts with near knee bent.
8: far foot approaching pelvis, near knee swings forward lifted.
9 opposite passing: FAR supporting leg nearly vertical; NEAR bent knee passes forward beside it, ankles close in x.
10: far supporting foot goes behind, near shin unfolds forward.
11: far heel lifts rearward, near heel approaches ground ahead, one equal phase before frame0.
Walk modest natural strides with both feet always readable, not running or skipping; no extreme high knees. Two subtle vertical pelvis bobs over the full cycle. Gentle opposite arm swing, hair/cloth secondary changes small and continuous. Keep same head size, body proportions and foot baseline; no camera/scale drift. No effects, speed lines, motion blur, ghosts, neighboring sprites touching or clipping. Fully clothed athletic poses.
Identity reference: image1 is Oichi's canonical approved character identity and costume ONLY. Adult Japanese woman, slim athletic legs, long HIGH black ponytail with small simple red/gold clasp, white sleeveless wrap top red trim, opaque red pleated short skirt and red sash, black/red forearm guards, white tabi socks/red wooden sandals. The long brown bow stays secured on her back in EVERY frame; same slim silhouette and crisp face as reference. Preserve costume coverage. Redraw the feet, knees and arm motion precisely according to the 12-phase plan.
rejected_passes.reason: Too many repeated wide strides, not complete alternating gait
